I didn't change anything, because the fix belongs in your page code, not in this repo.

This repo is boltons, and it has no page-title code. The underscores come from `boltons/strutils.py:89`:

```python
def slugify(text, delim='_', lower=True, ascii=False):
```

`delim` already lets you pick the separator. Wherever your app builds the title, pass a dash:

```python
slugify("Hello World", delim='-')   # 'hello-world'
```

I'd leave the default alone. Changing `delim` to `'-'` in boltons would silently change the output of every project that relies on the current behaviour, which makes it a breaking release. It would also break the doctests at lines 99 to 104 and need a CHANGELOG entry.

If you're maintaining a fork and actually want the default changed, I can flip it and update the docstring and doctests. Or point me at the repo with your page code and I'll add `delim='-'` there.
